title: fix: accept parameterized WebM MIME types in Gemini transcription uploa…
author: ale-rls

gist.summary: Gemini transcription now accepts unnamed WebM uploads with parameterized MIME types such as `audio/webm;codecs=opus`. The format resolver strips MIME parameters and sends canonical `audio/webm` to Vertex, while retaining filename precedence, MIME aliases, and rejection of unsupported formats. A regression test covers a browser-style upload and its returned transcription.
